title: Fix McpController 9-dependency god class decomposition
description:
## Source
Audit swarm finding F-AG2-12 (memorysmith-corpus-sweep4-audit-26-07-24-02-08-54)

## Problem
`McpController.cs` has 9 unrelated constructor-injected services and 394 lines acting as a dispatch hub. Same god-class pattern as `SqliteMemorySmithDatabase` (TSK-0157) and `MaintenanceAgentServices.cs` (TSK-0043).

## Severity
Medium

## Files
- `MemorySmith.App/Controllers/McpController.cs` (394 lines, 9 dependencies)

## Recommendation
Decompose into facade services per tool category (mirroring existing `McpAgentToolHandler` pattern).

## Existing Coverage
No existing task.
